verdict: Cost per lead improved sharply, but volume is thinning as spend pulls back.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 124 leads from Meta at an average cost of $11.19 per lead, with spend totaling $1,387. In the most recent week, spend was reduced by roughly half, and while cost per lead improved 36% week over week to approximately $7.63, lead volume has followed spend down — the last three days averaged 3.3 leads per day against a prior average of 5.7. Your Google Business Profile generated 198 actions this period, including 63 calls and 89 direction requests, which continue to run independently of paid activity. We are monitoring daily lead flow closely and will adjust spend levels if volume continues to thin below a workable threshold.

watch_item.issue: Lead volume is declining over the last three days as daily spend has dropped to a minimal level, and pipeline data is temporarily unavailable due to a connection issue — so lead-to-appointment conversion cannot be fully verified right now.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the spend floor to determine whether to restore budget, and the pipeline data connection is being restored so the full picture is visible ahead of the August 31st scorecard.
